items.title: AstraZeneca Data Breach – LAPSUS$ Group Allegedly Claims Access to Internal Data
items.description: The notorious hacking collective LAPSUS$ has resurfaced, allegedly claiming responsibility for a significant data breach involving the multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company AstraZeneca. The threat actors are currently attempting to sell a compressed 3GB internal data dump, signaling a potential shift towards pay-to-access extortion methods. LAPSUS$, previously known for…
